narrative: In the account book. The year's leaf, still headed 1594, the pen on the right-hand side under the lines from New Year's morning. In the account book. The next line, short, the fourpence from Friday. In the account book. The third payment, the same hand, no sum struck through. In the account book. The fourth line, and the pen lifted. No total under it. The coffer is not on the page.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the four lines and lifted the pen.

entities.name: the account book
entities.context: Shown on ledger in Four lines, and no new count
